headline_marked: Actor Azmeri Haque Badhon [[assaulted and harassed in Italy]] by Bengali youths
headline: Actor Azmeri Haque Badhon assaulted and harassed in Italy by Bengali youths
summary: The actress reported being physically attacked and harassed in Venice, alleging the perpetrators were affiliated with the Awami League and Chhatra League.
details: Actor Azmeri Haque Badhon was physically assaulted and harassed in Venice, Italy, while visiting a park with her brother's family.
Badhon alleged that a group of expatriate Bengalis attacked her, threw water and soft drinks at her, and attempted to hit her.
She further claimed that the attackers snatched her phone and threw it away, and struck her near her ear, causing her brother's young child to scream in fear.
The actress believes the attack was carried out by members of the Venice Awami League and Chhatra League due to her support for the July student-led uprising.
Filmmaker Mostofa Sarwar Farooki condemned the incident, urging the government to investigate those providing 'soft power' space to fascist elements within the administration.
Farooki criticized those who sympathize with the perpetrators of the July genocide and called for intellectual accountability for those who enabled fascist regimes.
The Milan Consulate has reportedly pledged all possible assistance to Badhon following the incident.
Various political leaders and members of parliament have also condemned the attack, calling for legal action against the perpetrators.
caption:
Actor Azmeri Haque Badhon was physically assaulted and harassed in Venice, Italy. She alleges the attack was politically motivated by Awami League affiliates.

Actor Azmeri Haque Badhon was physically assaulted and harassed in Venice, Italy, while visiting a park with her brother's family.

Badhon alleged that a group of expatriate Bengalis attacked her, threw water and soft drinks at her, and attempted to hit her.

She further claimed that the attackers snatched her phone and threw it away, and struck her near her ear, causing her brother's young child to scream in fear.

The actress believes the attack was carried out by members of the Venice Awami League and Chhatra League due to her support for the July student-led uprising.

Filmmaker Mostofa Sarwar Farooki condemned the incident, urging the government to investigate those providing 'soft power' space to fascist elements within the administration.

Farooki criticized those who sympathize with the perpetrators of the July genocide and called for intellectual accountability for those who enabled fascist regimes.

The Milan Consulate has reportedly pledged all possible assistance to Badhon following the incident.

Various political leaders and members of parliament have also condemned the attack, calling for legal action against the perpetrators.

headline: Chief Justice and 4 judges leave courtroom after lawyer's remarks on income
summary: Chief Justice Zubayer Rahman Chowdhury and Appellate Division judges walked out after SCBA President AM Mahbub Uddin Khokon claimed lawyers' incomes had declined since the CJ's appointment.
details: Chief Justice Zubayer Rahman Chowdhury and four Appellate Division judges left their courtroom today after SCBA President AM Mahbub Uddin Khokon commented on the declining incomes of lawyers.
caption:
A rare courtroom walkout: Chief Justice and four judges leave after a lawyer claims their incomes have dropped since the CJ took office.

Chief Justice Zubayer Rahman Chowdhury and four Appellate Division judges left their courtroom today after SCBA President AM Mahbub Uddin Khokon commented on the declining incomes of lawyers.
